title: PDV Phase 20 Breton tradition spine, focused tradition family, and three-track pressure implementation costing
p2Restraint: P2 audit-only. Transcribe the gate/ledger contracts into this schema; do NOT request new placement contracts or stronger reward volume beyond the gate and budget ledger. Stack audit is the deliverable, not new content.
paceAssumption: Breton is STATE-enum-gated by PDV_State_BretonTradition. Only the active tradition's focused family progresses; the focused patron within the active tradition is offer-like (piety Tier >= threshold). Assume ~1-2 qualifying tradition-coded signals per honest-play day within the chosen tradition; cross-track pressure (the three standing tracks) modifies access/penalty and does NOT add a parallel piety faucet. Switching traditions is blocked in V1 except authored forks, so a player banks pace inside one spine.
designRules: Tradition is the spine (R1/R7): rewards gate on PDV_State_BretonTradition (KnightsRoad | HiddenArt | GreenWay) plus the active tradition's focused patron tier within that state. Gods sit INSIDE the chosen tradition.

Broad lane is the Tradition state, not a deity: broad T1 is the FIXED manager property PDV_Bless_Breton_Tradition_T1 (R2) granted via PATRON_STATE_BROAD; broad T2 is PDV_Bless_Breton_Tradition_T2 (new). Do NOT create a flat Breton pantheon or generic broad-worship deity (R1, ledger).

Breton OWNS no Aedric deities (R5). Knight's Road focuses REUSE Imperial-owned Divines (Stendarr/Arkay/Mara/Julianos, plus Akatosh NATIVE) with create:false and a Stance_Breton added NATIVE. Green Way nature focus may reuse Kynareth (create:false). Hidden Art occult-lawful may reference Julianos (reuse).
Hidden Art Daedric forks and Green Way werewolf/Daedric forks route through the existing Phase 20C Daedric Prince system (R6). NO new Aedric or Daedric records here.

Exactly ONE tradition's focused reward family pays at a time (Overstack Risk control). The active PDV_State_BretonTradition value selects which of KnightsRoad/HiddenArt/GreenWay focused families is eligible; the other two are suppressed.

The three standing tracks (KnightlyVowIntegrity, WitchcraftExposure, DruidicStanding) are PRESSURE ONLY: they modify access, gate, penalize, or rupture. They are NEVER a second or third always-on boon family. They must not all pay positive rewards at once for the same character.
Hidden Art focused rewards may be stronger ONLY because WitchcraftExposure/rupture/Vigilant pressure is the price; the stronger magnitude is conditioned on visible exposure cost, not free.
Creed-violation loss fires on medium/major beats only (vow-integrity loss, exposure rupture, excommunication, druidic-fork betrayal); never raw ambient stat punishment.
Keep at most two always-on boon families: broad Tradition (Layer 1) plus the ONE active tradition's focused family (Layer 2). Broad stays softer than focused. No magnitude exceeds ~12%.

notes: The gate spine. One active tradition selects which focused reward family is eligible; the other two families are suppressed.
Normal tradition switching is blocked in V1 except authored rupture/fork paths.
There is no flat Breton pantheon: the broad lane is this state via PATRON_STATE_BROAD, not a deity record.
Green Way werewolf is a REAL fork, not a free hybrid with Hircine. The fork is authored, not a casual switch.
Betrayed is the druidic-fork betrayal creed-loss pole.
Werewolf-fork access routes any Daedric pressure through the Phase 20C system (R6), not new records.
PRESSURE ONLY. Modifies Knight's Road focused access and creates vow-breach pressure; it is NOT a boon track.
Vow breach moves integrity down and can trigger medium/major creed-violation loss; it does not pay positive rewards.
PRESSURE ONLY and the PRICE of Hidden Art strength. Higher exposure is the cost that justifies stronger occult rewards; it is NOT a second boon track.
Exposure/rupture is the gate that conditions Hidden Art focused magnitude; it also drives exposure-rupture creed-loss and Vigilant/social pressure.
Vigilant encounter chain stays extension scope; exposure bands carry the 1.0 pressure feel.
Relevant only while PDV_State_BretonTradition == HiddenArt (or Hidden Art pressure-eligible).
PRESSURE ONLY. Modifies Green Way focused access and gates the druidic fork; it is NOT a boon track.
Low standing plus the werewolf fork drives druidic-fork betrayal pressure.

immersionProof.signaturePromise: Breton devotion is a chosen tradition spine -- Knight's Road, Hidden Art, or Green Way -- that shapes identity, risk, and belonging; gods sit inside the tradition, and the three standing tracks are pressure, not three reward engines.
diegeticTriggerMeaning: Tradition is chosen explicitly and only one is active; the active PDV_State_BretonTradition selects which focused family pays.
Hidden Art gains power only as WitchcraftExposure/rupture/Vigilant pressure is paid; Knight's Road rewards concrete vows/mercy/service; Green Way rewards rites/standing-stones/outdoor covenant.
KnightlyVowIntegrity, WitchcraftExposure, and DruidicStanding modify access/penalty and rupture; they never become always-on boons.
feedbackSurface: Tradition messages and the tradition Survey copy explain the active spine and why parallel tradition rewards are not all active.
Band-crossing messages for vow integrity, witchcraft exposure, and druidic standing teach pressure and price; the Druidic Trial confrontation surfaces the werewolf fork.

Wire the three standing-track readbacks (KnightlyVowIntegrity/WitchcraftExposure/DruidicStanding) as pressure/access/rupture modifiers only.
